_note: UAV-A — fixed reference node hovering at 60m AGL. Role 'enb' is a simulator constraint (runs DL scheduler / EPC connection); physically this is a peer hovering UAV identical to ue0.

UAV-B — flyaway node. Starts 50m from enb0 at same altitude, moves directly away at 5 m/s constant groundspeed along +x. Over the 540s active window the node traverses from 50m to ~2750m separation. The constant_velocity model does not support waypoints, so the return leg (Step 7) must be run as a separate scenario with reversed velocity — see comments in run.ini.
